name: Inner Healing
overview: Scripture reveals that inner healing is a divine work where God restores the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds, offering both physical and spiritual restoration. The Psalms and Jeremiah affirm that God heals and saves those who call upon Him, emphasizing His power to restore health and mend grief. Additionally, Proverbs highlights the impact of a joyful spirit on well-being, contrasting it with the harm caused by a broken spirit. James underscores the role of mutual confession and fervent prayer among believers as a means through which healing is effected, pointing to the community's part in God's healing process.
